title: Debbi ER Probable NDE 7500
content: I remember I had felt very weak and unable to walk. I had fallen several times and so I had been put onto the front room sofa outside of my parent's bedroom to sleep. I felt very hot and tried to wake up but couldn't. I saw myself as a wispy cloud the size of my body, rising from my physical self. I began to float upwards towards the ceiling of my living room. As I came to the top of the room, I heard a voice behind me. Standing in my living room was a strange looking man, an Indian master-type gentleman with a turban on. He was saying, 'No, Debbi it is not your time to go. You must stay here.' I looked down on the sofa and saw me on the sofa, lifeless in appearance. I found myself having a pulled-back-into-my-body type sensation. He said, 'I am your angel. My name is Babba Ji. I have always been with you and will always be with you. I will get you some help. Look at the elephants marching around the room. Just watch them while I get you help.' I looked and marching around the ceiling were elephants. They were cartoon elephants like the ones on parade in the movie 'Dumbo'. I remember the first time I saw the Disney cartoon Dumbo I thought that's what I saw when I saw the angel. I remember my mother shortly afterward, not sure how long, came out and began screaming to my father to come and take me to the hospital. I remember my father becoming upset, he scooped up my body, and I blacked out again. Later, as a 35 year old, I had been visiting a friend in California and was invited to go to a talk from an 'Indian Guru Master.' When I arrived at the woman's house I was to ride with, I saw a picture of my angel. I couldn't believe it and asked her who was it? When did he live? She said she had been very sick with scarlet fever. He came to her and had dancing elephants for her to watch going around the room. She said his name was Babba Ji. I said this is unbelievable because that is what had happened to me. She said the man we are going to see tonight is Babba Ji's student's student. He had lived in 1880 and as a gift; she gave me the picture of him that I have framed in my home. I don't remember anything before this event. I know I have heard voices all my life that steer me in the right direction. The voices ask me to help people that need help, have saved people's lives, and helped me with daily life problems. I remember thinking as a child that I have parents but God was my true parent. I have always been intuitive, many times hearing people's thoughts and smelling spirits of family members. I could hear the voice of God or angels and this has created many adventures. These adventures are not normal for this earth as a result in my personal life and work environment as a nurse. I call them 'God jobs' and hear the voice at times that directs me how to help my patients and others.
